title: Motion with manners
prompt:
Add motion to the card, kindly:

1. Transition the hover lift: animate **`translate`** (or `transform`) and **`box-shadow`** only, never `all`, with durations between 100ms and 400ms.
2. Create a `@keyframes` animation that makes the `.live-dot::after` halo pulse **forever**, using only cheap properties (`scale`, `opacity`, `transform`, `translate`, `rotate`).
3. Make the transition and the pulse respect **`prefers-reduced-motion`** (the opt-in pattern with `no-preference` is recommended).
hints: `transition` accepts a comma-separated list: `translate 200ms ease-out, box-shadow 200ms ease-out`.
For the pulse, animate `scale` and `opacity` in `@keyframes`, and use `infinite` as the iteration count.
Put both the `transition` and the `animation` declarations inside `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { … }`.
explanation: Listing `translate` and `box-shadow` means only the lift animates; theme or layout changes stay instant. The pulse keyframes touch only `scale` and `opacity`, which browsers can animate on the compositor without recalculating layout. Wrapping both inside `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)` makes the motion opt-in: people who asked their OS to reduce motion get a static card and a static dot, while the "Live now" text still tells them what the dot meant.

checks.transition-specific: The hover transitions translate and box-shadow, not all
checks.pulse-loops: The Live dot halo pulses forever
checks.pulse-cheap: The keyframes animate only cheap properties
